# Michael Devlin — Founder & CEO, Ironwood Industrial

> Note: there are **two Michaels** in Kate's orbit. This is **Michael Devlin, the founder-CEO of
> Ironwood Industrial** (a portfolio company, external). The other is
> [Michael Brennan](michael-brennan.md), an SCP Partner (internal). Do not conflate them.

- **Relationship:** external; founder-CEO of SCP portfolio company
  [Ironwood Industrial](../projects/ironwood-industrial.md), which SCP is now selling.
- **Cadence:** monthly board call; more frequent during the exit.
- **Distinguishing fact:** **bootstrapped Ironwood for 18 years** before SCP's 2018 investment;
  he is emotionally attached to the business and its employees.

## Sensitivities — read before any exit communication
- **Do not blindside him on the exit process.** He learned about a *prior* strategic review from a
  banker before SCP briefed him, and he was furious. Every buyer conversation must be shared with
  him first. Keep him inside the tent on timeline and shortlist.
- Cares deeply about the plant workforce; a buyer's headcount plans are a hot button.
